name: print-social-purple-neon-tech-support-promo-with-cropped-title
title: Dark purple tech-support ad with a gamer silhouette, two-tone caps headline and a cropped word
whatItIs: A dark violet post with a logo, a person with headphones seen from behind facing monitors, 'Deliver Results' in light type, giant white and violet condensed caps 'NOT EXCUSES', a short line and a glowing 'DM to Start' pill, with a huge cropped word at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Bold and no-nonsense; neon purple on dark says technical competence.
techniques: Use a back-view silhouette facing glowing screens.
Crop a giant word at the base.

vocabulary.definition: A giant word cut by the bottom edge.
A button with a soft luminous edge.
